cases.observed: Spoken in two parts with a pause: "The kite is blue. Marker stays." with correct punctuation. Repeated attempts spoken in one go appended only "The kite is blue."
"The kite is green. Marker stays." exact; SEND callbacks 0; final text ~0.6 s after the apparent last tap (tap-to-Done mapping not certain)
With "Send me the report now." selected, the spoken instruction (English, then French) replaced the selection literally ("Rends ça plus poli"); no rewrite

android_reference.restored: Default IME restored to Gboard; PixelBoard IME disabled; touch timestamp capture stopped

findings: Native client received an intent 3 / field 7 polite rewrite from the real service; Strict render refused it as ambiguous by design. PixelBoard did not rewrite on this device.
Native single-utterance two-sentence dictation and targeted replacement were exact.
limits: Different audio (synthetic TTS vs live voice), network path and clock start; latencies are indicative, not a ranking.
One session per case, no repetition; not a quality or latency benchmark.
PixelBoard on a non-Pixel device is not official Gboard.
